comment: Provider rates for the live cost estimate. Verified 2026-09-05 against console.groq.com/docs/models and console.groq.com/docs/deprecations (primary sources). Estimates only: murmur recomputes historical costs at these current rates and assumes the cleanup pass runs. Update this file when rates drift and refresh verifiedOn.

stt.comment: USD per hour of audio transcribed. Groq bills ASR with a minimum of 10 seconds per request, which murmur honors per session.

llm.comment: USD per 1M tokens, input and output. The cleanup pass estimate assumes roughly 1.35 tokens per word plus a fixed prompt overhead.
